method: A district is residential land if the text of Div. 9 shows at least one dwelling type allowed there. Statuses are read from Div. 9 (use regulations); lot sizes from Div. 21 (bulk schedule); parking from Div. 15. Shares use our gross district acreage from the town's zoning layer (before NZA's removal of protected and unzoned land). Districts whose rules are not in the mirrored text are reported as unclassified and never guessed; their acreage appears in bounds, not in the base. As-of-right includes administrative site plan approval (no public hearing), matching how Stamford was treated.
acreage_note: Sum of Shape__Area grouped by Layer (district code). Shape__Area is Web Mercator m2 at latitude 41.03; corrected by cos^2(lat)=0.5691 and converted to acres. Total 31051 acres (matches Greenwich's ~31,000 acre footprint). Overlay codes (-HO, -HRO) are kept separately, so underlying base district areas may be understated by the overlay share.

parking_mandate_pct.basis: Every residential-base district is under Sec. 6-154 (single-family: 'sufficient' spaces), Sec. 6-155 (two-/multi-family table) or Sec. 6-110(e) (business zones use Sec. 6-155); so a mandate exists everywhere, but for single-family land it is not a numeric minimum.

R-6 two-family: Sec. 6-98(a)(3) says administrative site plan approval; Sec. 6-101(d) says special permit for two or more dwelling units on a lot in residential zones. Read as administrative (specific over general). If the special permit reading is right, R-6 2-family moves from as-of-right to hearing (978.0 acres, 3.3% of the base).

Business zones: Use Group 3 'dwelling units' are not typed as 1-, 2-, 3-family. We read up to 4 units as site-plan-only (Sec. 6-110(F)(1)) and 5+ units as special permit (Sec. 6-110(F)(2)); NZA may code business-zone housing differently, and may exclude some of these zones from residential land altogether.
WB 2-family: Use Group 7c lists only 'Multi Family Dwellings'; whether that includes two-family is not defined in the mirrored text. Left unclassified.
LBR-1: Sec. 6-103(G) lists Use Group 3 for all LBR zones but Sec. 6-110(c)(1) names only LBR-2.

Div. 9 is the Aug. 2023 edition; Sec. 6-110 amendments effective 5/6/26 and other later amendments (see build_data.py links) are not in the mirrored PDFs. NZA's coding date for Greenwich is not stated in our files.

NZA's stored proxy inputs in data/towns/greenwich.json (95.3/97.7/98.3 prohibited, 59.8 for >=80,000 sq ft) do not reproduce from the snapshot acres saved in nza_snapshots.json (96.0/97.9/98.5 and 65.0); the composite 82.7 matches the stored inputs only.
Overlay codes (-HO) are separate polygons in the acreage layer, so base-district acres may be understated (acreage method note).
